annotation.summary_en: Book review of Cheng Lin's RoboHumanities (imaginations, narratives and ethics regarding robots), published in Technology and Language. The supplied excerpt is only the front matter and contents of issue 7(3), on machine learning, language and Ramon Llull, so the review text itself is not visible.
key_provisions_or_claims: The supplied excerpt does not contain the review text.
The excerpt is the front matter and contents of an issue on machine learning, language pedagogy and Llull's thinking machine.
By title, the review covers a book on humanities approaches to robot imaginaries, narratives and ethics.
